asahi_installer.runtime_signers: 2026-11-06, read from the tarball's Mach-O code signatures in place (nothing run): 79 Mach-Os are signed by Developer ID Application: Python Software Foundation (BMM5U3QVKW) with the hardened runtime; Versions/3.13/lib/libffi.8.dylib is signed ad hoc, with no team; python.o, libtclstub8.6.a and libtkstub8.6.a are universal bitcode and static archives, not signed code. build-app.sh --release requires SEKKA_ENGINE_TEAM_ID to be runtime_team, and its audit allows that team only inside engine.tar.gz

runtime_adhoc.why: Asahi ships it signed ad hoc; ctypes needs it (Asahi's util.py and asahi_firmware/img4.py import ctypes), so it can't be left out, and re-signing it would change the engine's digest. Hashed 2026-11-06 from the pinned tarball. Notarization of an app carrying it inside engine.tar.gz is unconfirmed: if the notary log names it, re-sign the runtime at pack time instead.
